question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 1.2
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_quarter_id,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_quarter_id,
           SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
    SELECT pq.prod_id,
           pq.calendar_quarter_id,
           pq.product_sales,
           qt.total_sales as quarter_total,
           100.0 * pq.product_sales / qt.total_sales as share_pct
    FROM product_quarter_sales pq
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pq.calendar_quarter_id = qt.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_total_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
    FROM product_quarter_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rn,
           COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
    FROM product_total_sales
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE rn <= CAST(CEIL(0.2 * total_count) AS INTEGER)
),
q4_2019_shares AS (
    SELECT prod_id, share_pct as share_q4_2019
    FROM product_shares
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772
),
q4_2020_shares AS (
    SELECT prod_id, share_pct as share_q4_2020
    FROM product_shares
    WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
),
product_changes AS (
    SELECT t20.prod_id,
           q420.share_q4_2020,
           q419.share_q4_2019,
           q420.share_q4_2020 - q419.share_q4_2019 as pct_point_change
    FROM top_20_percent t20
    JOIN q4_2019_shares q419 ON t20.prod_id = q419.prod_id
    JOIN q4_2020_shares q420 ON t20.prod_id = q420.prod_id
)
SELECT prod_id, pct_point_change
FROM product_changes
ORDER BY ABS(pct_point_change) ASC
LIMIT 1
